description:
charisma comes from a RELEASE of tension

a lack of concern and a deep sense of SELF TRUST

the energy is ALWAYS accessible 

but by BUYING INTO the fear, doubt, worry, neediness, and anxiety 

you turn a RAGING RIVER into a BROKEN FAUCET

the WHOLE transition from boy to MAN is moving from outward - in…

to INWARD - OUT

the boy looks to everyone else to tell him who he is, what he can do, and how to see things

(mommy and daddy still dictating the terms)

the MAN sees through HIS OWN EYES

goes for what HE WANTS

TRUSTS HIMSELF

you MUST pass through your STORED PAIN to get BACK TO YOUR CENTRE 

to ACCESS your POWER

TAP IN.
transcript: you already have charisma. You have swagger, you have your own sense of humor, you have your own authentic way of expressing. But that's all trapped behind your insecurity, your tension, your fear of what people think of you, your need for their validation. As long as you need everybody to like you, you can't be yourself. And if that's your goal, you're never going to be that attractive. You're going to be bland, flavorless, because the real you is distinct. It's polarizing. It's powerful. And you're afraid of that power. So you hide it. You shelter yourself. You protect yourself. And you think that that's keeping you safe, but all that it's doing is isolating you. So you have to start to release that tension and step into your own. It's really the transition from being a boy to being a man. In the boy's mind, he still needs recognition and permission from mommy and daddy. And when you grow up, if you don't grow out of that mental model, it goes from mommy and daddy to everybody that's around you, to the people of status, to the people that have it figured out. And it's just not true. It's not an effective mental model. It was effective when you were three years old, but as a full-grown man, you gotta let it go.
